value: src/llm-instructions.ts. getEffectiveInstructions(surface: 'mcp'|'cli' = 'mcp') picks DEFAULT_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS (MCP handshake, unchanged) or CLI_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS (#117 WS2 — rvr-flavored, points at `rvr <cmd> --json`/RVR_OUTPUT and `rvr manifest`, drops the MCP-only "PREFER MCP TOOLS"/confirm_token language that was actively wrong for a CLI agent), then appends any custom system.llm.instructions as a PROJECT CONTEXT block. MCP server calls it with no arg (mcp). View via `rvr config llm-instructions [--surface mcp|cli] [--default]`. AGENTS.md emitted by init mirrors the CLI blob.
